title: Clan riders and wall archers
changes: Every clan now fields riders: Warden lancers, Redfang raiders, Host bone riders, Hide-Kin boar riders and Veiled dune riders. A rider lowers its weapon and marks its lane before it charges: step aside or take a heavy, staggering hit.
Pikemen brace against a charge and stop the rider cold.
Archers now stand on the walls and towers of clan forts and shoot at enemies outside. Troop archers no longer shoot through walls or rock.
